title: Mesherra Provenance Ledger Entry v1
description: An append-only, signed entry in a single principal's residue ledger. Each entry records one action this principal took or observed. Authoritative source: mesherra/src/mesherra/models/primitives.py (Residue). This JSON Schema is the runtime-validation and cross-language mirror.

ledger_owner.description: Principal that owns this ledger shard.

task_id.description: The A2A task.id this entry pertains to.

context_id.description: The A2A context_id tying multi-turn interactions together.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-ledger entry index, starting at 0.

previous_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the previous entry in this ledger (hex). Empty string for sequence=0.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this entry was recorded.

actor.description: Principal that performed the action. For emit entries this equals ledger_owner; for receive entries it is the remote principal.

counterpart.description: Principal on the other side of the interaction.

action_type.description: Direction of the action from this ledger's perspective.

operation.description: What kind of action it was.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical JSON (JCS) encoding of the payload referenced by this entry.

payload_schema.description: Schema ID of the payload that was hashed (e.g., meshycal.scheduling/proposal-v1).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (base64) over the canonical JSON encoding of this entry with the signature field omitted. Verified against actor's public key.
